title: Bar Drop Banana Lemon 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Salts Banana Lemon by Drop is a unique and vibrant fusion that plays with contrasting flavour profiles. The inhale introduces the soft, creamy sweetness of ripe bananas, providing a mellow foundation. This is instantly brightened by a zesty twist of sharp lemon on the exhale. The combination of creamy fruit and citrus zest creates a dynamic, layered vape that is both comforting and refreshingly sharp. This e-liquid is mixed with a 40% VG / 60% PG ratio, a specification chosen to maximise the intensity of the flavour concentrate. The higher PG level ensures the sharp lemon notes pop against the creamy banana background. Designed for use with MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) pod kits, it utilises nicotine salts for a smooth throat hit in 5mg, 10mg, or 20mg strengths, delivering a discreet vapour with a powerful taste. Bar Drop Salts is a range of nic salt e-liquids from UK manufacturer, Drop, that specialises in creating fruity flavours of astonishing authenticity and clarity.
